summary: Key risks: U.S.-Iran conflict (easing after ceasefire), Venezuela instability, NATO posture in Greenland, China overcapacity (EVs, solar, semiconductors) driving trade tensions. Oil price spikes from Strait of Hormuz concerns fed inflation fears. Despite these, Morgan Stanley forecasts continued bull market with near double-digit S&P 500 returns. Jamie Dimon cautioned on complex risk environment.
